topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Oh my gosh, you won't believe what I found today at this little yard sale down the street. It was tucked away in a box, covered in dust, but I knew it the second I saw it—my childhood teddy bear! I mean, the button nose is a bit rusty, and he's got this one threadbare spot on his ear from all the hugging, but he’s still got that same old stitching. I can’t even tell you how many times I slept with him, how many secrets we shared. Bringing him home felt like a big, warm hug from the past. It's amazing how these old things can pop up and just... bring it all back, you know?
